text: Applicants must provide a copy of their Emirates ID and a copy of their passport as part of the equivalency application.
label: OFFICIAL

text: Applicants must submit original certificates for grades 10, 11, and 12. MOE returns these original certificates to the applicant after verification is complete.
label: OFFICIAL

text: If a certificate is issued in a language other than Arabic or English, it requires a legal/certified translation in addition to the required attestation before it can be accepted.
label: OFFICIAL

text: Beyond the Emirates ID, passport, and original grade 10-12 certificates, a more detailed checklist (e.g. personal photographs, per-subject transcripts, copies of each attestation stamp) is commonly listed by private attestation/consultancy agencies assisting applicants. This could not be verified against an official MOE checklist document in this session: the official 'Guide to Academic Certificate Equivalency' PDF linked from MOE's e-services pages returned a 404, and a second official 'Applicant Welcome Kit' PDF is a scanned image with no extractable text. Treat any document requirement beyond doc-001 through doc-003 as unconfirmed until the official checklist PDF is retrieved and read.
label: ASSUMPTION
